repos_data.description: Lightweight and Memory efficient terminal for Mac built with SwiftUI and libghostty
Swift/AppKit terminal multiplexer for Claude Code + shell sessions
A terminal workbench in pure Rust: shells, persistent sessions, SSH, coding agents. GPU-rendered on Zed's gpui, VT core from Alacritty.
LLM-native terminal emulator for macOS — AI components, multi-provider profiles, voice input, Metal GPU rendering
A keyboard-first menubar app to monitor and jump between AI coding sessions — minimum setup required.
Manage multiple Claude Code, OpenCode agents from either TUI or Web for easy access on mobile. Also supports Mistral Vibe, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Pi.dev, Copilot CLI, Factory Droid Coding.
A macOS hotkey that opens your terminal at the right repo with your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, …) already running. Free, open source, local-only.
👻 Ghostty is a fast, feature-rich, and cross-platform terminal emulator that uses platform-native UI and GPU acceleration.

The god agent for solopreneurs on Mac. Opens terminal sessions it can undo, runs agent swarms, builds iOS apps, and writes its own next version for you to approve. 39 features, 79 tools, MIT, your key or a local model.
Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and VPS.
A native macOS app that shows what's draining your battery — live power, per-app energy, charge history, and drain insights. 100% local, no dependencies.

repo_meta_data.description: A native macOS terminal for running AI coding agents in parallel — built on real libghostty, with persistent tmux-style sessions and a scriptable Lua/CLI control plane.
